steps: Apply online on the scholarship e-Kalyan portal.
Enter your Aadhaar number, name, date of birth, gender, and mobile number in the registration form.
Use the generated application ID to complete further application steps.
Provide details of your Aadhaar-linked bank account under your name.
Upload the required documents to the portal.
parsed.department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
